description: As-issued history for backtests (no look-ahead): kind=daily (every source's daily hi/lo/rain per run at a place), nbm (NBM text columns: TXN, XND, P12, Q12; view=day = the books' day view), obs (settlement truth: CLI, routine-METAR max/min) or markets (what the markets tool served, each change; asof = as it stood then). from/to (<= 366 days, 1 unit per 31 days); run=ISO | lead=N (+cycle=H: the run issued N days before) | asof=ISO (what was known then). Rows carry fetched_at and origin (bf:* = backfilled). TSV by default. format=json also returns structuredContent; the JSON Schema is at https://groundhog.markets/api/v1/schema.json

asof.description: newest run fetched by this UTC time (no look-ahead); markets: each row as it stood then

cycle.description: with lead: only runs at H UTC

fields.description: full (default) | compact: leave out null JSON keys (format=json)

lead.description: the run issued N UTC days before each date

place.description: slug, name or ICAO (kind=daily, markets; nbm/obs: its station)

source.description: kind=daily: source ids, comma list (e.g. nbm,gfs,ifs)

name: history
title: As-issued history
